title: tc-co-occurrence
description:
Entities ranked by how often they appear together with a subject – strength in words and bars, a score, the share
of events, a count per source and when last seen – with each row opening its shared events.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

window.description: The time window the counts cover, shown in the header, e.g. "120-day window"

sources.description: The data sources, in the order their counts are shown

entities.description: The entities seen together with the subject

events.description: How many events the subject had in the window – the share's denominator

eventUnit.description: What an event is called after a number: "14 of 17 events"

sort.description: The order of the rows. Changed by the user unless a tc-sort-change listener calls preventDefault()

selected.description: The open row's id. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

thresholds.description: The lowest shares, from 0 to 1, that count as Always together and Frequent; below Frequent is Occasional

strengthLabels.description: The strengths' names, merged over the defaults (Always together, Frequent, Occasional)

locale.description: The language for dates and numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

CoSource.description: A data source the events come from, e.g. { id: "pay", label: "Payments" }

detail.description: A second line: an ID, a device, a company

together.description: How many of the subject's events they were in; the share is this over `events`

lastSeen.description: When they were last seen together, epoch ms

events.description: The shared events, listed by source when the row opens

CoEvent.description: One event the entity and the subject shared
